notes.notes:
Run and gun your way deep into the neo-humanoid territory and save mankind from its own creation! 
Fight as special ops commander Layla in this mutant blasting weapon rich 2D action sci-fi shooter!

notes.title: Strip Fighter Zero is released!
notes.notes:
The bawdy spoof filled origin game of the "Strip Fighter" series of 90's style 2D fighting games finally hits the scene!

An underground fighting tournament filled with deadly fighters and martial artists.
Their fierce battle for supremacy is about to unfold!
